note.en: 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient. Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

name.ja: 静止湖：表現した床の上の湿潤・露出平衡
name.en: Lake at rest: wet and emerged equilibrium over represented bed

note.ja: 1次元、g=9.81、長さ25m、8<x<12でz=.2−.05(x−10)²m。水位.5/.1mの静水は200セル、流量4.42m²/s・下流深さ2mの定常流は100/200/400セル、t=2s。地形は区分定数セル平均。定常流から開始し、静水からの定常化実験とは区別します。 解析解 g9.81、[0,25]m、200セル。8<x<12の放物線床z=.2−.05(x−10)²をセルごとにGauss8で平均し、h_i=max(η₀−z_i,0)、q_i=0、η₀=.5/.1mを初期化します。静水再構成が保つのはこの表現した区分定数床の平衡であり、連続床上の水深平均をそのまま使う別問題ではありません。 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。
note.en: 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient. Analytic reference Use g9.81,[0,25]m and200cells. Represent z=.2−.05(x−10)² on8<x<12 by split Gauss8 cell means, initializing h_i=max(eta0−z_i,0),q_i0 with eta0=.5/.1m. Hydrostatic reconstruction preserves equilibrium over this represented piecewise-constant bed; this differs from directly averaging depth over the continuous bed. Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope.

name.en: SWASHES steady flow: subcritical Bernoulli root

note.ja: 1次元、g=9.81、長さ25m、8<x<12でz=.2−.05(x−10)²m。水位.5/.1mの静水は200セル、流量4.42m²/s・下流深さ2mの定常流は100/200/400セル、t=2s。地形は区分定数セル平均。定常流から開始し、静水からの定常化実験とは区別します。 半解析解 g9.81、[0,25]m、同じ放物線床、流量q4.42m²/s、下流h2m。h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g)の非射流根を別の二分法で求め、セル平均求積を比較します。100/200/400セルのPDE計算は定常参照から初期化してt2まで進め、SWASHESの静止状態からの過渡計算そのものは再現しません。 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。
note.en: 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient. Semi-analytic reference Use g9.81,[0,25]m, the parabolic bed, discharge q4.42m²/s and downstream depth2m. Independently bisect the subcritical root of h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g) and qualify cell quadrature. PDE runs on100/200/400cells start from the steady reference and advance to t2; they do not reproduce the original rest-to-steady transient. Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope.
